title: I Bought $10,000 of These Stocks Ahead of Earnings. Here's Why
creator: Couch Investor
summary: Couch Investor reviews a rough stretch — his portfolio down 1.42% on the week and 14.2% on the month, though still up 25.1% year to date against the S&P 500's 11.45% — and walks through buy zones for his book ahead of what he calls the mother of all earnings weeks, with SoFi, PayPal, Robinhood, Alphabet, Microsoft, ServiceNow, Intel, Amazon, SanDisk and Reddit all reporting. He plays clips from Nebius and from Amazon/AWS arguing that AI capacity is sold out for 2026 and largely for 2027, then discloses $10,000 of dip-buying: ten extra Nebius shares at $160 into his largest position, ten Nvidia shares (a 30% position increase) because it is cheap, five Alphabet shares at the $320 close (up 3.8%), still inside a buying zone capped at $342, and three Meta shares at $642 (up 5.2%), inside his main $630–$645 zone with resistance at $663 then $700-plus. He also thinks Google Cloud could grow about 100% year over year this quarter, while expecting Alphabet's free cash flow to stay negative on capex. The long technical-analysis section gives buy zones for many other names (Rocket Lab, SoFi, Amazon, Nu, Netflix, Reddit, Axon, MercadoLibre, Uber, Broadcom, CoreWeave, AMD and others) without trades, so only the four disclosed buys are recorded as calls: NBIS, NVDA, GOOGL and META — all BUY reiterated.

calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 2026-10-22; no flip) — he bought 10 extra Nebius shares at $160 ahead of earnings, calling it bargain hunting; Nebius is his #1 portfolio position.
calls.base_case: The whole neocloud segment is under pressure and this earnings season is the separator: names that show progress, execution and a clear path to becoming a huge business should rebound.
calls.bull_case: Big long-term contracts (Meta, Microsoft) bring forward funding and de-risk the build-out, while management keeps at least half of capacity for higher-margin on-demand and enterprise demand at current prices.
calls.bear_case: Names that do not execute 'will be crushed'; his bargain zone was $140–$150, weekly-50 support sits around $160 and big resistance is above $200 at $217.
